Agent Name: Grocery_Expert
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: They miscalculated proximity in their manual check, effectively using an incorrect blocks-per-mile conversion and misinterpreting distances to the park boundary. This led them to conclude that no stores were within 2 blocks, even though at least Big Apple Finer Foods at 2345 N Clark St is about 1–2 blocks from Lincoln Park. They then prematurely declared “no qualifying supermarkets” without validating prices, producing the wrong final answer.
